name: check-exhausted-036
description: A slice whose test check fails every time: each red check sends it back to implement until the counter test.fail (5) runs out and the slice ends stuck, naming it; the story's slices step then ends stuck too. Tick 36: slices.slice_stuck,unit.ended.stuck.

story.name: story
story.description: Slice a planned story against the current base, run the slices, verify the story, open the draft PR, wait for CI.

sync-resolve.agent: Base mode: merge the base commit named in Rework into the story branch in this worktree, resolve, commit the merge; never rebase.

means.done: base merged into the story branch, conflicts resolved and committed

slice.agent: Write slice files to slices/<nn>-<slug>.md in the spec folder. A slice has no QA of its own: list every slice's criteria in spec.md's frontmatter `criteria` too, each id prefixed with its slice number (`01.AC1`), next to the story's own, so the story's QA gives each one a verdict. First check the Plan section of spec.md against the code on this base: when spec.md has no Plan section, or the base changed what the plan relies on so that it no longer holds, write no slice files, say what no longer holds in the handoff's Notes and report `replan`.

means.done: slice files written against the current base; every user story is covered by some slice's acceptance
means.replan: spec.md has no Plan, or the base no longer fits it: what no longer holds is in the handoff; the person replans with `norn story edit <story> --workflow refinement --at plan`

approve-slices.gate: Review the slice files in the spec folder (edit them if needed). Approve to start the slices, or reject with what to change.

resolve.agent: Base mode: merge the base commit named in Rework into the story branch in this worktree, resolve, commit the merge; never rebase. When Rework holds the resolution review's findings instead, fix the resolution they name and commit; never rebase.

means.done: base merged into the story branch, conflicts resolved and committed

resolution-review.agent: Review only the resolution: each remerge-diff under Inputs is where a merge differs from git's own merge of its parents, a base change the resolver dropped included. Judge whether it keeps the intent of both sides. Report `redescribe` when the merge danger pr.md describes no longer holds.

means.approve: the resolution keeps both sides' intent, no blocking findings; pr.md still describes the merge danger
means.redescribe: the resolution is sound, but the merge danger pr.md describes changed
means.changes_requested: blocking findings on the resolution in the receipt

qa.agent: The criteria are spec.md's frontmatter `criteria`; an id `<nn>.<id>` is criterion `<id>` of slice file `<nn>-*.md`, which says what it means.

means.pass: every acceptance criterion of the story and its slices observed with evidence
means.fail: a criterion fails; repro in findings
means.partial: criteria only a person can judge, evidence prepared
means.unverified: criteria this session could not check; how to check each one is in the report

human-qa.gate: Check the criteria QA could not settle (listed with how to check each). Approve, or reject with what failed.

implement.agent: Rework the story in its worktree: the failing check, QA repro, CI failure or person's rejection the inputs name. Each rework point gets a test that fails before the code changes.

means.done: every rework point has a passing test

review.agent: Review the story-level rework against the findings it answers and the spec: it fixes what they ask and nothing else.

means.approve: the rework does what the findings and the story ask and nothing else, no blocking findings

describe.agent: Write the PR body to pr.md in the spec folder; norn puts the issue link under it.

means.done: pr.md describes the branch as it is now: summary, evidence, merge danger

ci.check:
command -v gh >/dev/null || { echo "gh not found: no CI to wait for"; exit 0; }
pr=$(gh pr view --json number -q .number) || exit 1
sha=$(gh pr view --json headRefOid -q .headRefOid) || exit 1
# GitHub starts no CI run on a PR that conflicts with its base: exit 3 is stale, the story
# updates its branch instead of waiting. UNKNOWN is GitHub still computing: asked again briefly.
mergeable() {
  m=UNKNOWN
  for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
    m=$(gh pr view "$pr" --json mergeable -q .mergeable) || return 1
    [ "$m" != UNKNOWN ] && return 0
    sleep 5
  done
}
conflicting() { [ "$m" = CONFLICTING ] && echo "PR conflicts with its base: no CI runs on it until the branch takes the base"; }
mergeable || exit 1
conflicting && exit 3
n=0
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  n=$(gh pr view "$pr" --json statusCheckRollup -q '.statusCheckRollup | length') || exit 1
  [ "$n" -gt 0 ] && break
  sleep 10
done
if [ "$n" -eq 0 ]; then
  mergeable || exit 1
  conflicting && exit 3
  echo "no checks on PR #$pr after 5m (PR mergeable: $m): nothing to wait for"
  exit 0
fi
gh pr checks "$pr" --watch --interval 30 >/dev/null && exit 0
gh pr checks "$pr"
# where the failures are, never the log: a failed step's log buries the failure in passing output
gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/$sha/check-runs?per_page=100" -q '.check_runs[] | select(.conclusion=="failure") | "- \(.name) (id \(.id)): \(.details_url)"'
echo "Read a failed check run's annotations (file, line, message):"
echo "  gh api \"repos/{owner}/{repo}/check-runs/<id>/annotations\" -q '.[] | select(.annotation_level==\"failure\" and .path!=\".github\") | \"\\(.path):\\(.start_line) \\(.message)\"'"
echo "Only if that is not enough, the full log is behind its link."
exit 1

ready.gate: Read the draft PR. Approve to wait for the merge (a person merges the PR), or reject with what to change.
